FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS:
TeleCom Solutions, Inc. provides cable and telecommunications services, specializing in the installation and repair of low-voltage wiring and consumer electronics for residential and commercial clients. Our operations include retail sales of audio/visual equipment, rental services for event-related gear, and technical support for network infrastructure. We maintain a strong commitment to safety through documented training programs and rigorous compliance with operational standards. Additionally, we limit exposure to third-party liabilities by ensuring that subcontractors provide their own certificates of insurance. We strategically operate within low-risk environments to minimize potential losses and uphold a solid record of safety and reliability in our services.

Our business frequently relies on off-premises utility services to maintain seamless cable and telecommunications connectivity for our customers, ensuring optimal performance and reliability in our operations.

FIELDS.G6: Do you lease employees to or from ot: No – TeleCom Solutions, Inc. does not lease employees to or from other employers, as our operations focus on self-sufficient staffing for cable and telecommunications services. FIELDS.G7: Any Workers Compensation carried?: No – TeleCom Solutions, Inc. does not carry Workers Compensation insurance. This is in line with their operations and current insurance arrangements.

FIELDS.G10: Are you involved in manufacturing,: No – TeleCom Solutions, Inc. is not involved in manufacturing, mixing, relabeling, or repackaging of products. Our operations focus solely on providing cable and telecommunications services and retail sales of audio/visual equipment.
FIELDS.G11: Do you rent or loan equipment to ot: No – TeleCom Solutions, Inc. does not rent or loan equipment to others, which aligns with our operational focus and risk management practices. This approach minimizes potential liabilities associated with equipment rentals.
FIELDS.G12: Has applicant had a foreclosure, re: No – TeleCom Solutions, Inc. has not had any foreclosure, repossession, bankruptcy, judgment, or lien during the past five years, maintaining a solid financial standing.
FIELDS.G13: Any exposure to flammables, explosi: No – TeleCom Solutions, Inc. does not have any exposure to flammables, explosives, or chemicals as our operations focus solely on low-voltage wiring and consumer electronics, which do not involve such materials.
FIELDS.G14: Any catastrophe exposure?: No – Coverage is eliminated for loss or damage caused by utility service failures occurring off-premises, which aligns with the business's operations and risk management practices.
FIELDS.G15: Any past losses or claims relating: No – TeleCom Solutions, Inc. has not had any past losses or claims relating to sexual abuse or molestation allegations, discrimination, or negligent hiring. FIELDS.G16: Any uncorrected fire code violation: No – TeleCom Solutions, Inc. does not have any uncorrected fire code violations, ensuring compliance with all safety standards and regulations.
